item.title: External Field Driven Oxygen Reduction Reaction: From Catalytic Chemistry, Mechanistic Characterization to Device Applications
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely bridges atomic-level ORR catalyst design (heteroatom coordination, dual-atom sites, single-atom/cluster coupling) with external field coupling (light, magnetism) and device integration in zinc-air batteries, H2O2 electrosynthesis, and PEM fuel cells. Its cross-scale framework and proposed future directions—mass transport engineering, multi-field coupling, and data-driven paradigms—offer significant guidance for practical catalyst commercialization.

item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Local heteroengineering on VO₂(B) creates an electronic reconstruction: electrons transfer to higher-energy V t₂g orbitals, boosting conductivity, while interfacial charge redistribution generates a reversible built-in electric field that drives NH₄⁺ (de)intercalation and lowers diffusion barriers. This enables 214.7 mAh g⁻¹ (near 2/3 theoretical capacity) and excellent rate performance, offering a new route to efficient ammonium-ion storage.
🏷 ammonium-ion supercapacitor · VO2 heterostructure · electronic reconstruction · built-in electric field · NH4+ intercalation

item.title: NiN 4 C‐Coordination Stabilized Cobalt‐Based Single Cluster Catalyst with High Active Site Density: Rationally Designed Atomic Architecture Boosts Oxygen Reduction Activity
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a gradient pyrolysis strategy that sequentially anchors NiN₄C sites and Co₃O₅ fragments, forming an atomically precise Co₃O₅NiN₄C single-cluster catalyst that transforms in situ into active Co₃O₁NiN₄C. Significance: the triangular Co₃ motif enables side-on O₂ adsorption, lowering the O–O dissociation barrier, yielding exceptional ORR activity (0.923 V half-wave), high site density (4.16×10²⁰ g⁻¹), and 247.3 mW cm⁻² in Zn-air batteries.
🏷 single-cluster catalyst · oxygen reduction reaction · NiN4C coordination · zinc-air battery · cobalt oxide cluster

item.title: Electric‐Field‐Coupled Heterointerface Engineering via Li/F Co‐Doping for Enhanced Rate Capability and Interfacial Stability of Fe/Mn‐Based Layered Sodium Cathodes

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in an in situ strategy combining bulk Li/F co-doping with a surface heterojunction coating, creating a built-in electric field at the heterointerface. This synergistically enhances crystal stability, accelerates Na⁺ kinetics, and improves air/interfacial stability. It enables superior rate capability and cycling stability in P2-type Fe/Mn-based cathodes, offering a new design approach for high-rate sodium-ion battery cathodes.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · layered oxide cathode · Li/F co-doping · heterointerface · built-in electric field

item.title: Photosynthetic chimeric stem cells function as mitochondrial batteries
item.description:
سلول‌های بنیادی کایمریک فتوسنتزی با تیلاکوئید گیاهی و mRNA کدکننده FGF21 به‌عنوان باتری میتوکندری، انتقال میتوکندری و هموستاز انرژی را تقویت کرده و ترمیم زخم را در مدل‌های موش و خوک تسریع می‌کنند.
Science Advances | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in creating cross-kingdom photosynthetic chimeric stem cells by inserting plant thylakoids and FGF21 mRNA into enucleated mesenchymal stem cells. This "mitochondrial battery" uses light to enhance mitochondrial transfer, restore damaged cell metabolism, and sustain energy homeostasis via FGF21. Significance: it overcomes donor stem cell limitations (poor engraftment, aberrant differentiation), enables repeatable modular mRNA therapies, and accelerates wound repair in mouse and pig models.
🏷 mitochondrial transfer · chimeric stem cells · thylakoid · FGF21 mRNA · wound healing

item.title: Alleviating the stability-energy density dilemma via electron-donor-mediated orbital symmetry regulation in sodium phosphate cathodes
item.description:
با مکانیسم اهداکننده الکترون و تنظیم تقارن اوربیتال در کاتد فسفات سدیم، اعوجاج اکتاهدرال ناشی از Mn3+ مهار شده و چگالی انرژی ۴۹۲ Wh/kg با پایداری چرخه‌ای بالا در باتری سدیم-یون حاصل می‌شود.
Science Advances | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in an electron-donor–mediated mechanism using Fe³⁺/V³⁺ co-doping to delocalize Mn 3d electrons, symmetrizing e_g orbital occupancy and suppressing Mn³⁺-induced octahedral distortion while preserving high-spin activity. This resolves the stability–energy density trade-off, enabling 492.06 Wh kg⁻¹, 178.8 mAh g⁻¹ at 0.1 C, and 80.2% retention over 2000 cycles—advancing high-performance sodium-ion battery cathodes.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · sodium phosphate cathode · orbital symmetry · Mn3+ distortion · electron donor
